# Trend (`trend`)

A reading over time: big latest value, sparkline and range.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTrend` (types in `dist/web/charts/trend.d.ts`): `.mh-trend`: a reading over time. `__text` holds `__name`, the big `__reading` (`__value` in tabular figures and `__unit`) and the `__range` line; `__chart` holds a `.mh-sparkline` with an area. Side by side, wrapping to a stack when narrow; consecutive trends are divided by a rule, so several sit well in one card.

```ts
export function createTrend(options: TrendOptions): TrendHandle;

export interface TrendOptions {
  /** What is measured ("Living room"). */
  name: string;
  /** The latest reading; `null` shows a dash. */
  value: number | null;
  /** Unit after numbers ("°C", "%", "kWh"). */
  unit?: string;
  /** Readings over time, oldest first; `null` is a gap. Drawn as a sparkline with an area. */
  values: SparklineValues;
  /** The line under the value ("19.5–21.3 °C over 12 h"). Default: low–high of `values` with the unit. */
  range?: string;
  /** Sparkline colour (default accent). */
  color?: SparklineColor;
  /** Formats numbers (value, range, the chart's accessible summary). Default: as given. */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
}

export interface TrendHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown. */
  update(options: TrendOptions): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTrend, type TrendOptions } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const values = [19.2, 19.0, 18.8, 18.9, 19.4, 20.1, 20.8, 21.3, 21.6, 21.4, 21.9, 21.5];

const options = (latest: number): TrendOptions => ({
  name: 'Living room',
  value: latest,
  unit: '°C',
  values,
  format: (v) => v.toFixed(1),
});

const trend = createTrend(options(21.5));

// Each new reading joins the chart and becomes the value shown.
setInterval(() => {
  const latest = Math.round((20 + Math.random() * 2) * 10) / 10;
  values.push(latest);
  values.shift();
  trend.update(options(latest));
}, 5000);

document.body.append(trend.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Trend } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TrendExample() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState([19.2, 19.0, 18.8, 18.9, 19.4, 20.1, 20.8, 21.3, 21.6, 21.5]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const latest = Math.round((20 + Math.random() * 2) * 10) / 10;
      setValues((prev) => [...prev.slice(1), latest]);
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <Trend
      name="Living room"
      value={values[values.length - 1] ?? null}
      unit="°C"
      values={values}
      format={(v) => v.toFixed(1)}
    />
  );
}
```
